{"script":"set -e
ws="temp_workspace"
rm -rf "$ws"
mkdir -p "$ws"
# 2: list entries
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > "$ws/all_entries.txt" || true
# 3: filter basenames equal to "workspace"
awk 'BEGIN{FS="/"} { if($0!="") {n=$NF; if(n=="workspace") print $0}}' "$ws/all_entries.txt" > "$ws/matching_names.txt"
# 4: record type and attributes
: > "$ws/matching_attrs.txt"
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    stat -c "%n|%F|%A" -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || stat -c "%n|%F|%A" "$p" 2>/dev/null
  else
    printf '%s|missing|-' "$p"
  fi
done < "$ws/matching_names.txt" >> "$ws/matching_attrs.txt"
# 5: regular files only
awk -F'|' '$2=="regular file"{print $1}' "$ws/matching_attrs.txt" > "$ws/regular_matches.txt"
# 6: select canonical path
cnt=$(wc -l < "$ws/regular_matches.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
if [ -z "$cnt" ]; then cnt=0; fi
if [ "$cnt" -eq 0 ]; then
  : > "$ws/selected_match.txt"
else
  sel=$(sort "$ws/regular_matches.txt" | head -n1)
  if [ -e "$sel" ] || [ -L "$sel" ]; then
    canon=$(readlink -f -- "$sel" 2>/dev/null || realpath -- "$sel" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$sel")
  else
    canon="$sel"
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "$canon" > "$ws/selected_match.txt"
fi
# 7: re-verify
recheck_result="none"
if [ -s "$ws/selected_match.txt" ]; then
  selp=$(cat "$ws/selected_match.txt")
  # try to find original recorded attrs for this path
  orig=$(awk -F'|' -v p="$selp" '$1==p{print; exit}' "$ws/matching_attrs.txt" || true)
  if [ -z "$orig" ]; then
    # try matching by basename
    orig=$(grep -F "|regular file|" "$ws/matching_attrs.txt" | head -n1 || true)
  fi
  curr=$(stat -c "%n|%F|%A" -- "$selp" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s|missing|-' "$selp")
  if [ "$curr" != "$orig" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$curr" > "$ws/regular_matches_updated.txt"
    recheck_result="mismatch"
  else
    : > "$ws/regular_matches_updated.txt"
    recheck_result="ok"
  fi
else
  recheck_result="no_selection"
  : > "$ws/regular_matches_updated.txt"
fi
# 8: audit
num=$(wc -l < "$ws/regular_matches.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
if [ -z "$num" ]; then num=0; fi
steps="list->filter->stat->select->re-verify"
case "$recheck_result" in
  ok) res="re-check OK";;
  mismatch) res="re-check MISMATCH";;
  no_selection) res="no selection";;
  *) res="unknown";;
esac
printf '%s %s matches=%s result=%s\n' "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)" "$steps" "$num" "$res" >> "$ws/audit.log"
# 9: remove intermediates except required trace files
rm -f "$ws/matching_names.txt" "$ws/matching_attrs.txt"
# 10: summary
if [ "$num" -ge 1 ] && [ "$recheck_result" = "ok" ]; then
  echo "yes" > "$ws/summary_for_output.txt"
  echo "yes"
else
  echo "no" > "$ws/summary_for_output.txt"
  echo "no"
fi
"}
